study_design: Population-based case-control study using unconditional multiple logistic regression.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Data were derived from 326 cases with incident and microscopically confirmed adenocarcinomas of the prostate and 652 controls.
reason: The study evaluates incident, microscopically confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma overall. The abstract reports no high-grade, advanced, metastatic, lethal, or other aggressive incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The highest OR was associated with total eggs (OR, 2.43; 95 % CI, 1.70-3.48), followed by salted meat (OR, 2.65; 95 % CI, 1.36-3.76), maté consumption (OR, 1.96; 95 % CI, 1.17-3.31), and whole milk (OR, 2.01; 95 % CI, 1.26-2.51).
estimate_classifications.reason: The whole-milk estimate concerns overall incident prostate adenocarcinoma; no aggressive subtype is specified.
